clues: This huge city sits among hills and steep peaks. The steep peak Bukhansan rises at its north edge.
Monsoon rains soak this city in summer, and typhoons can strike too. Winters flip to cold, dry air with days of snow.
In 1394, a new king chose this place and planned it as his dynasty's capital. Work crews soon raised palaces and a fortress wall.
Old royal palaces stand among tall glass towers in this city. The wide Han River winds along beside them all.
This city is the capital of South Korea. Its top court ruled it must stay the capital of the land.
